integrity: The infinite-family theorem is supported by an explicit proof; finite exact-rational checks supplement rather than replace it. No claim of independent review or validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted prisms only; canonical Euclidean-orthogonal cut/cycle projections, not global minimum projection constants. Full text of a relevant 2017 resistance study unavailable for complete bibliographic comparison. Logarithmic expansion has an O(1/n) remainder with unresolved finer oscillatory term.
title: Exact endpoint Hodge norms and the rim–rung transition on circular ladders
